cd <workspace>; cat > tests/test_spec.py <<'EOF'
import os
import tempfile
import unittest

from confkit import ParseError, load, loads


def err(text, **kw):
    try:
        loads(text, **kw)
    except ParseError as exc:
        return exc.message.split(":")[0], exc.lineno
    raise AssertionError("no error")


class SpecTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_scalars(self):
        r = loads("a=1_000\nb=-0b101\nc=.5\nd=5.\ne=1e3\nf=00.5\ng=007\nh=1__0\ni=TRUE\nj=inf\nk=0x\nl=1e\n")
        self.assertEqual(r, {"a": 1000, "b": -5, "c": .5, "d": 5.0, "e": 1000.0,
                             "f": .5, "g": "007", "h": "1__0", "i": True,
                             "j": "inf", "k": "0x", "l": "1e"})

    def test_inline_comments(self):
        self.assertEqual(loads("u = http://h/a#b\nx = a;b\ny = 1 ;c\n[s] # c\n"),
                         {"u": "http://h/a#b", "x": "a;b", "y": 1, "s": {}})

    def test_lists(self):
        self.assertEqual(loads("a = [it's, [1, 2], \"x\",]\n"), {"a": ["it's", [1, 2], "x"]})
        self.assertEqual(loads("a = [1, # c\n  2]\n"), {"a": [1, 2]})

    def test_errors(self):
        self.assertEqual(err("a = [1,,2]\n"), ("invalid list", 1))
        self.assertEqual(err("a = [,]\n"), ("invalid list", 1))
        self.assertEqual(err("a = [1 2]\n"), ("invalid list", 1))
        self.assertEqual(err("\nx = 1\na = [1,\n 2\n"), ("unterminated list", 3))
        self.assertEqual(err('a = "x" y\n'), ("unexpected text after string", 1))
        self.assertEqual(err('a = "\\q"\n'), ("invalid escape", 1))
        self.assertEqual(err("  x\n"), ("continuation without a value", 1))
        self.assertEqual(err("[a]\n  x\n"), ("continuation without a value", 2))
        self.assertEqual(err("[a\n"), ("invalid section header", 1))
        self.assertEqual(err("a b = 1\n"), ("invalid line", 1))
        self.assertEqual(err("a = 1\na.b = 2\n"), ("key conflict", 2))
        self.assertEqual(err("a.b = 1\na = 2\n"), ("key conflict", 2))
        self.assertEqual(err("a = 1\n[a]\n"), ("key conflict", 2))
        self.assertEqual(err("[a]\n[a]\n"), ("duplicate section", 2))
        self.assertEqual(err("@include \"x\"\n"), ("include needs a base directory", 1))
        loads("[a.b]\n[a]\n")

    def test_value_error_beats_duplicate(self):
        self.assertEqual(err('a = 1\na = "x\n'), ("unterminated string", 2))

    def test_multiline_comments_skipped(self):
        self.assertEqual(loads("h =\n  a\n# c\n\n  b # p\nn = 1\n"), {"h": "a\nb", "n": 1})

    def test_crlf_and_bom(self):
        self.assertEqual(loads("\ufeffa = 1\r\nb = 2\rc = 3\r\n"), {"a": 1, "b": 2, "c": 3})


class IncludeSpecTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_include_cycle_and_sections(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
            def w(n, t):
                with open(os.path.join(d, n), "w") as f:
                    f.write(t)
                return os.path.join(d, n)
            main = w("m.ini", "[a]\n@include 'sub.ini'\nx = 1\n")
            w("sub.ini", "top = 1\n[b]\ny = 2\n")
            self.assertEqual(load(main), {"a": {"x": 1}, "top": 1, "b": {"y": 2}})
            c = w("c.ini", "@include \"c.ini\"\n")
            with self.assertRaises(ParseError) as ctx:
                load(c)
            self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.message.split(":")[0], "include cycle")
            self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.source, c)
            m2 = w("m2.ini", "@include \"nope.ini\"\n")
            with self.assertRaises(ParseError) as ctx:
                load(m2)
            self.assertTrue(ctx.exception.message.startswith("cannot read include"))
            with self.assertRaises(OSError):
                load(os.path.join(d, "missing.ini"))
